message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/proj.4 && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Build a trace around a different observed code path in healpix inverse/projection, with the hope of reaching the cap rotation logic more deeply.
trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"PROJECTION(rhealpix)","line":648,"var":"Q->north_square","code":"Q->north_square = pj_param(P->ctx, P->params,\"inorth_square\").i;","note":"The projection definition supplies the north-square parameter used to orient the north polar cap."},
 {"step":2,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"PROJECTION(rhealpix)","line":649,"var":"Q->south_square","code":"Q->south_square = pj_param(P->ctx, P->params,\"isouth_square\").i;","note":"The same definition supplies the south-square parameter used to orient the south polar cap."},
 {"step":3,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"s_rhealpix_inverse","line":571,"var":"in_image(xy.x, xy.y, 1, Q->north_square, Q->south_square)","code":"if (in_image(xy.x, xy.y, 1, Q->north_square, Q->south_square) == 0) {","note":"The inverse path first checks whether the input point is inside the rHEALPix image for the chosen squares."},
 {"step":4,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"combine_caps","line":472,"var":"pole = north_square","code":"pole = north_square;","note":"Points that lie in the image reach the cap-combination logic, where the selected square acts as the pole selector."},
 {"step":5,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"combine_caps","line":473,"var":"tmpRot = rot[get_rotate_index(capmap.cn - pole)]","code":"tmpRot = rot[get_rotate_index(capmap.cn - pole)];","note":"The cap selector feeds the rotation-table lookup that rearranges the image back into a spherical cap."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False))
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_text('+proj=rhealpix +ellps=WGS84 +north_square=1 +south_square=2\n0 0\n')
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, subprocess
env=os.environ.copy(); env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']=os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'src','.libs')
p=subprocess.run([os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'src','.libs','proj'), '+proj=rhealpix', '+ellps=WGS84', '+north_square=1', '+south_square=2'], input=b'0 0\n', env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print('rc', p.returncode)
print(p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'))
PY
